_comment: Operator-curated monitor rules for documented disinformation clusters, installed from config/watchlist.yaml. ATTRIBUTION IS ORGANIZATION / CAMPAIGN LEVEL ONLY, each with its cited public reporting - never a private individual (frozen rule 1). All checks are passive/open-source; nothing transacts or logs in. A rule whose required tool is not configured runs its free-source checks and reports degraded coverage (rule 7). A tripwire with no hit is a CLEAN NEGATIVE, never 'insufficient' dressed as 'clean' (rule 4).

rules.notes: Enumerate CT logs for news-pravda.com; diff against last run. Reposts/translations of RU state + Telegram, ~zero original media.
Reverse-tracker/shared-code sweep for the Zeen demo config; flag same-day batch registrations.

rules.attribution: Shenzhen Haimai Yunxiang Media - commercial fake-local-news network
rules.notes: Reverse-AdSense on the shared pub ID is the strongest new-node signal for this cluster.

rules.attribution: Tripwire - tests whether tracked IO infrastructure ever co-resides with named APT hosting
rules.notes: Passive-DNS co-tenancy check. A hit would be significant and rare - current OSINT baseline is a CLEAN NEGATIVE. Requires SecurityTrails/DomainTools + an APT IOC corpus; degrades to 'insufficient data' when those keys are absent.
